This candidate tests the opposite side of that tradeoff: cap the grid at 256 CTAs, increasing per-CTA grid-stride work, to see whether lower atomic contention outweighs reduced parallelism on large inputs. It is unmeasured; the controller should check correctness and repeated timings against both prior results and the baseline.
